verdict.rationale: Navan documents natural-language querying of spend/travel data via its MCP server (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.), with concrete example prompts like flagged-expense queries and policy-violation checks, plus Ava AI for summarizing/analyzing travel spend and Navan Edge for conversational trip booking with confirmation steps. This spans multiple product surfaces (expense, travel, card management) via natural language. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP natural-language experience and no first-party demo/video showing real conversational interaction beyond documented example prompts.
